newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR WEAKENS AMID CONTINUED PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR WEAKENS AMID CONTINUED PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against hard currencies on Thursday morning as most banks, in a last minute bid to stock up for a big import payment later in the day, engaged in brisk U.S. dollar buying, dealers said.

"There was a lot of buying as soon as we opened and the local dollar moved to 10.9675/9825. The Reserve Bank had to come into the market in a big way (to support the local currency)," one dealer said.

However, he added that the Zimbabwe dollar was likely to appreciate later on, when those banks that failed to secure the bid for the U.S.$10 million payment sought to rid themselves of their excess U.S. dollar reserves.

At around 0750 GMT, after the central bank's intervention, the Zimbabwe unit was trading at 10.9600/9750 against the U.S. dollar compared to its overnight 10.9350/9500 and was also quoted weaker on sterling at 17.7840/8190 from 17.7060/7410.
It was at 6.6770/6910 against the mark from 6.6620/6730 and at 2.4020/4070 versus the rand, down from 2.3970/4020 at Wednesday's close. --Stella Mapenzauswa, Harare Newsroom:
